title: Implement compact TUI goal display
objective: Show active goal state in the TUI without changing the main workflow.
context: The TUI already receives slash command metadata and maintains session state.
The display should be a compact indicator, not a full task dashboard.

source_evidence.note: Post-command TUI state updates can refresh goal display after /goal.

include: Add a GoalViewState or equivalent projection.
Render a compact active indicator with safe truncation.
Refresh state after /goal command execution and session resume.

implementation_steps: Find the current status bar render path.
Add a small goal view state field.
deliverables: TUI shows active goal status compactly.
risks: repl_tui.go status updates can conflict with other in-flight edits.
dispatch_prompt: Implement compact TUI goal display to satisfy tui goal tests. Refresh after /goal and session resume, keep no-goal rendering unchanged, and avoid redesigning the UI.
notes_for_assignee: If root.go is not the actual status renderer, use the real file and update owned_files in your report.
